name: Hypsometric
description: Layer tints of a relief map, each level a flat ink holding a dot of the next level up that swells as the ground rises, so the bands dither into each other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --n: @rn(-0.4, 4.4, 1.3); --v: $(max(0, min(3.999, n))); background: @match($(v) < 1, @p(var(--color1)), $(v) < 2, @p(var(--color2)), $(v) < 3, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @match($(v) < 1, @p(var(--color2)), $(v) < 2, @p(var(--color3)), $(v) < 3, @p(var(--color4)), @p(var(--color5))); -webkit-clip-path: circle(@calc(72 * ($(v) - floor($(v))))% at 50% 50%); clip-path: circle(@calc(72 * ($(v) - floor($(v))))% at 50% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
